The '''Fishing Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{Coll|Pufferfish}} collection at {{coll|Pufferfish 2}}, {{coll|Pufferfish 5}}, {{coll|Pufferfish 7}}, {{coll|Pufferfish 9}}, and {{Coll|Pufferfish 10}} with increasing capacity. The Small Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the Medium Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the Large Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item. Beginner Sack holds {{Green|640}} items, but only includes vanilla resources. The Large Enchanted Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of enchanted items.

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
A '''Beginner Fishing Sack''' can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Fishing Merchant}} in the [[Hub]] near the {{Zone|Fishing Outpost}}.
